listing.title: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 134m², Budva, Crna Gora
Sale, two bedroom apartment, 134m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Predstavljamo vam dvosoban stan povrsine 134.55m2 koji je lociran na 6. spratu kompleksa u izgradnji na prvoj liniji mora u Budvi.
Rok zavrsetka april 2028.
Raspored plaćanja je sledeći:-Rezervacija: 10.000 € (nepovratno)-30% kupoprodajne cene – u roku od 10 dana od potpisivanja Preliminarnog ugovoraPreostali iznos kupci plaćaju u tri rate:Prva rata 30% – nakon završetka konstrukcijeDruga rata 30% – nakon završetka završnih radovaTreća rata 10% – prilikom primopredaje nekretnineOvaj jedinstveni kompleks nalazi se u samom epicentru turističke Budve, na šetalištu, okružen fantastičnim prirodnim uslovima kao što je neopisiv panoramski pogled koji prepliće najbolje od Budvanske rivijere sa modernim objektima, sadržajima i uslugama hotela sa 5 zvjezdica. Stambene jedinice dostupne za prodaju nalaze se od četvrtog do devetog sprata. Ovi pažljivo dizajnirani stanovi pružaju savršen spoj luksuza i funkcionalnosti, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na okolinu. Deseti sprat je isključivo posvećen penthaus apartmanima, koji se mogu pohvaliti raskošnim sadržajima kao što su hidromasažne kade i prostrane terase. Ukupno ima 66 apartmana dostupnih za kupovinu uključujući sobe, apartmane i penthaus apartmaneKompleks poseduje dva ulaza, jedan pogodno lociran na šetalištu, a drugi pristupačan sa bulevara. Glavni ulaz, koji se nalazi u aneksu kongresnog centra, omogućava lak pristup raznim događajima i konferencijama. Sadržaji KompleksaKompleks nudi poslovni prostor, prodavnice i servisni centar, dva restorana i kafić sa pogledom na Jadransko more, spa centar sa bazenima i teretanom, kao i konferencijske sadržaje. Podzemni objekti obuhvataju tehničke prostorije, kao i podzemni parking sa ukupno 160 parking mjesta. Usluge i SigurnostKonsijerž i 24-časovno obezbjeđenje jamče vaš mir i sigurnost. Naša raznolika ponuda hotela s pet zvjezdica i sadržaja Budve pretvara vašu investiciju u luksuzni stil života. Zelena OazaOvaj savremeni objekat također nudi zelenu oazu na krovu konferencijske sale, gdje ćete uživati u prirodi.
Poseban fokus stavljen je na održavanje zelenih površina, koje će vlasnicima i gostima omogućiti sezonsko uživanje u prirodi i lokalnoj flori na kućnom pragu. Pogodnosti-DVA HOTELSKA RESTORANA,KAFIĆ KANCELARIJE I PRODAVNICE NA PRVIM SPRATOVIMA.-SPA CENTAR SA TERETANOM I BAZENIMA ZELENA OAZA NA KROVU BRENDIRANE REZIDENCIJE.-Tehničke prostorije i podzemni parking-Brendirane rezidencije s uslugom održavanja-Paketi namještaja dostupni za useljenje

We present to you a two bedroom apartment with an area of 134.55m2, which is located on the 6nd floor of a complex under construction on the first line of the sea in Budva.
Completion Date: April 2028Payment Schedule:Reservation: €10,000 (non-refundable)30% of the purchase price – within 10 days of signing the Preliminary AgreementThe remaining amount is paid in three installments:First installment 30% – after completion of the structural constructionSecond installment 30% – after completion of the finishing worksThird installment 10% – upon handover of the propertyThis unique complex is located in the very heart of tourist Budva, on the promenade, surrounded by fantastic natural conditions and offering an indescribable panoramic view that combines the best of the Budva Riviera with modern facilities, amenities, and five-star hotel services.
The residential units available for sale are located from the 4th to the 9th floor. These carefully designed apartments provide a perfect blend of luxury and functionality, with stunning views of the surroundings. The 10th floor is exclusively dedicated to penthouse apartments, featuring luxurious amenities such as jacuzzis and spacious terraces.
In total, there are 66 apartments available for purchase, including standard units, apartments, and penthouses.
The complex has two entrances, one conveniently located on the promenade and another accessible from the boulevard. The main entrance, located in the annex of the congress center, provides easy access to various events and conferences.
Complex Amenities:The complex offers commercial spaces, shops, and a service center, two restaurants and a café with a view of the Adriatic Sea, a spa center with pools and a gym, as well as conference facilities. The underground facilities include technical rooms and an underground parking area with a total of 160 parking spaces.
Services and Security:Concierge and 24-hour security ensure peace of mind and safety. The diverse offering of five-star hotels and amenities in Budva turns your investment into a luxurious lifestyle.
Green Oasis:This modern building also features a green oasis on the roof of the conference hall, where residents can enjoy nature. Special attention is given to maintaining green spaces, allowing owners and guests to enjoy seasonal greenery and local flora at their doorstep.
Additional Benefits:Two hotel restaurants, café, offices, and shops on the lower floorsSpa center with gym and pools, green rooftop oasis, branded residencesTechnical rooms and underground parkingBranded residences with maintenance servicesFurniture packages available for move-in

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 87m², Tivat, Crna Gora
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 87m², Tivat, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Nekretnine Crna Gora,Tivat-Predstavljamo vam novi rezidencijalni kompleks koji se nalazi u srcu Porto Montenegra, u kvartu Sinhro grada Tivta. Ovaj projekat nekretnina je magični spoj elegancije, udobnosti i najsavremenijeg dizajna, kreiran da ispuni sva vaša očekivanja i još mnogo toga.
Projekat obuhvata tri stambena bloka i krovni bazen koji povezuje dva odvojena bloka. Svaka zgrada ima luksuzne stanove i prostrane penthause, savršeno projektovane od najkvalitetnijih materijala.
Možete birati između 40 različitih stanova u rasponu od jednosobnih 49m2 do fantastičnih penthouse apartmana od 321m2.
Na prodaju je i 6 poslovnih jedinica.
Usluge i pogodnosti:• Privatni konsijerž• Infiniti bazen na krovu• Privatno obezbeđenje• Podzemna garaža• Namenske skladišne jedinice• Sistem pametne kućeOsnovni paket uključuje elegantan dizajn enterijera, sa mogućnošću izbora između dva stila - italijanskog i nordijskog. Dodatno, na zahtev, svaki stan može biti opremljen i opremljen najkvalitetnijim nameštajem i opremom.
Kompleks se nalazi pored luksuzne marine za mega-jahte Porto Montenegro iu neposrednoj blizini međunarodnih škola i aerodroma u Tivtu, Podgorici i Dubrovniku.
Pored nagrađivane marine, Porto Montenegro se može pohvaliti šarmantnim rezidencijalnim delom, hotelom Regent sa pet zvezdica, luksuznim buticima, prodavnicama, restoranima, sportskim i rekreativnim sadržajima, koji privlače živu međunarodnu zajednicu tokom cele godine.
Ulaganje u sigurnost i prosperitetUlaganjem u projekat obezbeđujete zagarantovan povraćaj uloženih sredstava od 6% godišnje. Ovo je prilika za pametno ulaganje, kombinujući luksuz sa finansijskom sigurnošću.
Dodatno, na zahtjev klijenta, svaki apartman može biti u cjelosti opremljen najkvalitetnijim namještajem i ugradnim elementima. Trenutno postoje 2 posebne ponude:Prilikom potpisivanja kupoprodajnog ugovora pre 1. juna 2025. godine, svaki apartman na poklon dobija parking mesto u podzemnoj garazi i individualnu ostavu.
Pri kupovini rezidencija 106, 108, 113, 403 i 404 - kompletno opremanje i namještaj na poklon!#NekretnineCrnaGora #Tivat #PortoMontenegro #PogledNaMore #Investicija #NovKompleksSaBazenom #LuksuzniStanovi #StanoviUIzgradnji

Discover an exceptional new residential development in the heart of Porto Montenegro, in Tivat’s prestigious Synchro district — where contemporary architecture, refined elegance and an exclusive Mediterranean lifestyle come together.
A NEW STANDARD OF LUXURY LIVING
The development comprises three residential blocks, featuring a spectacular rooftop infinity pool connecting two of the buildings. Every residence is thoughtfully designed with premium materials, sophisticated finishes and meticulous attention to detail.
RESIDENCES DESIGNED FOR YOUR LIFESTYLE
• 40 exclusive apartments, ranging from 49 m² one-bedroom residences to magnificent 321 m² penthouses • 6 commercial units available for purchase • Two elegant interior design concepts: Italian and Nordic • Optional bespoke furnishing and complete interior fit-out
EXCLUSIVE AMENITIES & SERVICES
• Private concierge service • Rooftop infinity swimming pool • 24/7 private security • Underground parking garage • Dedicated private storage units • Smart home technology
AN UNBEATABLE LOCATION
Situated just steps from the world-renowned Porto Montenegro superyacht marina, the development offers immediate access to luxury boutiques, fine dining restaurants, the five-star Regent Hotel, sports and recreational facilities, and international schools.
Tivat International Airport is nearby, with Podgorica and Dubrovnik airports also accessible for international travel.
A LIFESTYLE THAT INSPIRES. AN INVESTMENT THAT STANDS OUT.
Porto Montenegro is one of the Adriatic’s most prestigious luxury destinations, combining an award-winning marina with an elegant waterfront community and a vibrant international atmosphere throughout the year.
The project is promoted with a 6% annual return on investment. Investors should request the contractual terms, guarantee structure and conditions to verify how this return is secured.
SPECIAL PURCHASE BENEFITS
Availability and current terms should be confirmed with the sales team.
• Underground parking space and private storage room — previously offered as complimentary benefits for purchases contracted before June 1, 2025. This promotion has expired unless renewed by the developer.
• Complimentary furnishing and interior decoration — previously advertised for residences 106, 108, 113, 403 and 404. Please enquire about current availability and whether this offer remains valid.
Looking to invest in Montenegro’s luxury real estate market or secure your own residence in Porto Montenegro?
Contact us for current availability, apartment layouts, pricing and investment details.

Na prodaju ekskluzivan duplex apartman ukupne površine 119 m², smešten u luksuznom boutique kompleksu The Cube u Krašićima, na poluostrvu Luštica. Ova moderna nekretnina pruža savršen spoj savremenog dizajna, privatnosti i vrhunskog kvaliteta života, uz spektakularan panoramski pogled na more i planine.
Kompleks se nalazi u mirnom delu Krašića i predstavlja jedinstvenu privatnu celinu sa svega 9 apartmana i 2 luksuzne vile, čime se obezbeđuje visok nivo komfora i ekskluzivnosti. Apartman se prostire na dve etaže. Na prvom nivou nalazi se prostrani dnevni boravak sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom, gostinski toalet i izlaz na veliku terasu sa otvorenim panoramskim pogledom. Na drugom nivou smeštene su dve komforne spavaće sobe, pri čemu svaka soba poseduje svoje privatno kupatilo, pružajući dodatnu udobnost i privatnost. Na ovoj etaži se nalazi i tehnička prostorija sa veš mašinom, bojlerom i dodatnim prostorom za odlaganje.
Apartman je završen i spreman za useljenje. Projektovan je sa velikim staklenim površinama koje omogućavaju obilje prirodne svetlosti i nesmetan pogled na Jadransko more i okolne planine.
Stanari kompleksa imaju na raspolaganju zajednički bazen dužine 20 metara koji se održava tokom cele godine, kao i dve uređene lounge zone za odmor. Posebna prednost kompleksa je što vile imaju sopstvene bazene i garažna mesta, dok glavni bazen koriste isključivo vlasnici apartmana, što dodatno doprinosi privatnosti.
Nekretnina poseduje kompletnu dokumentaciju. Garažno parking mesto dostupno je uz doplatu.

For sale is an exclusive duplex apartment with a total area of 119 m², located in the luxury boutique complex The Cube in Krasići, on the Lūštica Peninsula. This modern property offers a perfect blend of contemporary design, privacy, and a high quality of life, with a spectacular panoramic view of the sea and mountains.
The complex is situated in a peaceful area of Krasići and represents a unique private unit with only 9 apartments and 2 luxury villas, ensuring a high level of comfort and exclusivity. It is located in an excellent location, about 15 minutes by car from Tivat Airport and a few minutes from the prestigious Lūštica Bay complex.
The apartment spreads over two floors. On the ground floor there is a spacious living area with a kitchen and dining room, a guest toilet, and access to a large terrace with an open panoramic view. On the second floor there are two comfortable bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, providing additional convenience and privacy. There is also a utility room with a washing machine, boiler, and additional storage space on this floor.
The apartment is completed and ready for moving in. It is designed with large glass surfaces that allow plenty of natural light and an unobstructed view of the Adriatic Sea and the surrounding mountains.
The complex residents have access to a 20-meter-long swimming pool that is maintained throughout the year, as well as two furnished relaxation areas. A special advantage of the complex is that the villas have their own swimming pools and garage spaces, while the main pool is used exclusively by the apartment owners, which further contributes to privacy.
The property has complete documentation. A garage parking space is available for an additional fee.

Na prodaju je urbanizovan plac površine 2122m² u naselju Gornja Gorica, Podgorica. Plac je idealan za izgradnju porodičnih kuća, vila sa bazenom, kao i vila bez bazena, sa podrumom-garažom, prizemljem, prvim spratom i potkrovljem.
Za grupisane urbanističke parcele postoji mogućnost gradnje većih objekata do tri sprata. Oko placa je izgrađena ulica širine 8,5m sa asfaltom i trotoarima, uključujući fekalnu kanalizaciju, oborinsku kanalizaciju, vodovodnu mrežu sa ostavljenim priključcima za buduće objekte, elektro instalacije, telekomunikacione instalacije i javnu rasvetu.
Plac je odlično povezan sa infrastrukturom i nalazi se u neposrednoj blizini novog naselja "City kvart", tržnih centara "Delta City" i "City Mall", kao i Univerziteta Crne Gore.
Ova lokacija pruža odličnu priliku za razvoj stambenih i komercijalnih objekata. Idealno za investitore koji žele da iskoriste potencijal rasta i razvoja u ovom delu Podgorice.

For Sale: Urbanized Plot of Land in Gornja Gorica, Podgorica – 2122m²This urbanized plot of land, covering an area of 2122m², is located in the Gornja Gorica neighborhood in Podgorica. The plot is ideal for the construction of family houses, villas with pools, as well as villas without pools, with a basement-garage, ground floor, first floor, and attic.
For grouped urban planning parcels, there is the possibility of building larger buildings up to three floors. The area around the plot has a street built to a width of 8.5m, with asphalt and sidewalks, including sewage, stormwater drainage, a water supply network with connections left for future buildings, electrical installations, telecommunications installations, and street lighting.
The plot is well-connected with infrastructure and is located near the new "City Quarter" neighborhood, "Delta City" and "City Mall" shopping centers, and the University of Montenegro.
This location offers an excellent opportunity for the development of residential and commercial properties. It is ideal for investors looking to take advantage of the growth and development potential in this part of Podgorica.

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 466m², Budva, Crna Gora
Sale, house, 466m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Na prodaju rustična vila u Paštrovskom stilu, 2,5 km od Petrovca (Kruševica), u mirnom i izolovanom dijelu. Plac površine 578 m² je popločan kamenom i ima poseban prilaz, garaže za 5 vozila, fitnes salu i bazen od 31 m².
Vila ima ukupno 466 m² stambenog prostora. U prizemlju se nalaze dnevni boravak, kuhinja sa izlazom na dvije terase, dvije spavaće sobe, kupatilo i gostinski toalet. Na spratu su dva fizički odvojena dvosobna stana sa sopstvenim kupatilima i terasama.
Ukupno: 6 spavaćih soba, 5 kupatila, 3 kuhinje, 4 terase. Gradnja započeta 2009, završena 2013. Uknjiženo 1/1, upotrebna dozvola izdata.
067/231-153

For sale, a rustic villa in Paštrovići style, 2.5 km from Petrovac (Kruševica), in a quiet and isolated part. The land plot with an area of 578 m² is paved with stone and has separate access, garages for 5 vehicles, a fitness room, and a pool of 31 m².
The villa has a total of 466 m² of living space. On the ground floor there are a living room, a kitchen with access to two terraces, two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a guest toilet. On the first floor are two physically separated two-bedroom apartments with their own bathrooms and terraces.
Total: 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, 3 kitchens, 4 terraces. Construction started 2009, completed 2013. Registered 1/1, occupancy permit issued.

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 88m², Tivat, Crna Gora
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 88m², Tivat, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Predstavljamo vam novi rezidencijalni kompleks koji se nalazi u srcu Porto Montenegra, u kvartu Sinhro grada Tivta. Ovaj projekat nekretnina je magični spoj elegancije, udobnosti i najsavremenijeg dizajna, kreiran da ispuni sva vaša očekivanja i još mnogo toga.
Prilikom potpisivanja kupoprodajnog ugovora pre 1. juna 2025. godine, svaki apartman na poklon dobija parking mesto u podzemnoj garazi i individualnu ostavu.
Pri kupovini rezidencija 106, 108, 113, 403 i 404 - kompletno opremanje i namještaj na poklon! Projekat obuhvata tri stambena bloka i krovni bazen koji povezuje dva odvojena bloka. Svaka zgrada ima luksuzne stanove i prostrane penthause, savršeno projektovane od najkvalitetnijih materijala.
Možete birati između 40 različitih stanova u rasponu od jednosobnih 49m2 do fantastičnih penthouse apartmana od 321m2.
Na prodaju je i 6 poslovnih jedinica.
Usluge i pogodnosti:• Privatni konsijerž• Infiniti bazen na krovu• Privatno obezbeđenje• Podzemna garaža• Namenske skladišne jedinice• Sistem pametne kućeOsnovni paket uključuje elegantan dizajn enterijera, sa mogućnošću izbora između dva stila - italijanskog i nordijskog. Dodatno, na zahtev, svaki stan može biti opremljen i opremljen najkvalitetnijim nameštajem i opremom.
Kompleks se nalazi pored luksuzne marine za mega-jahte Porto Montenegro iu neposrednoj blizini međunarodnih škola i aerodroma u Tivtu, Podgorici i Dubrovniku.
Pored nagrađivane marine, Porto Montenegro se može pohvaliti šarmantnim rezidencijalnim delom, hotelom Regent sa pet zvezdica, luksuznim buticima, prodavnicama, restoranima, sportskim i rekreativnim sadržajima, koji privlače živu međunarodnu zajednicu tokom cele godine.
Ulaganje u sigurnost i prosperitetUlaganjem u projekat obezbeđujete zagarantovan povraćaj uloženih sredstava od 6% godišnje. Ovo je prilika za pametno ulaganje, kombinujući luksuz sa finansijskom sigurnošću.

We present to you a new residential complex located in the heart of Porto Montenegro, in the Synchro neighborhood of the city of Tivat. This real estate project is a magical blend of elegance, comfort and state-of-the-art design, created to meet all your expectations and more.
When signing the sales contract before June 1, 2025, each apartment comes with a complimentary parking space in the underground garage and a private storage room.
For the purchase of residences 106, 108, 113, 403, and 404 – full furnishing and interior decoration included as a gift!
The project includes three residential blocks and a rooftop swimming pool connecting two separate blocks. Each building has luxurious apartments and spacious penthouses, perfectly designed from the highest quality materials.
You can choose from 40 different apartments ranging from one bedroom 49m2 to fantastic penthouse apartments of 321m2.6 business units are also for sale.
Services and benefits:• Private concierge• Infinity pool on the roof• Private security• Underground garage• Dedicated storage units• Smart home systemThe basic package includes an elegant interior design, with the option of choosing between two styles - Italian and Nordic. Additionally, upon request, each apartment can be furnished and equipped with the highest quality furniture and equipment.
The complex is located next to the luxury marina for mega-yachts Porto Montenegro and in the immediate vicinity of international schools and airports in Tivat, Podgorica and Dubrovnik.
In addition to an award-winning marina, Porto Montenegro boasts a charming residential area, the five-star Regent Hotel, luxury boutiques, shops, restaurants, sports and recreational facilities, which attract a vibrant international community throughout the year.
Investing in security and prosperityBy investing in the project, you ensure a guaranteed return on invested funds of 6% per year. This is an opportunity for a smart investment, combining luxury with financial security.

Rok završetka: april 2028.

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 223m², Reževići, Budva
Sale, house, 223m², Reževići, Budva
listing.description:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 223 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 306 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata četiri spavaće sobe, cetiri kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje. Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.

For sale is a luxury townhouse villa with an area of 223 m² with a private plot of 306 m² and a swimming pool, located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes four bedrooms, four bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of space and plenty of natural light, while two terraces offer a breathtaking view of the Adriatic Sea. The plot features a private swimming pool, a landscaped and green courtyard, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property brings special benefits — the possibility of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from the property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive a right to a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of high-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica. Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa represents a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for rental.

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 58m², Bečići, Budva
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 58m², Bečići, Budva
listing.description:
Prodaja jednosobnog stana 58 m² sa pogledom na more u ekskluzivnom stambenom kompleksu u Rafailovićima – prvi red do mora sa privatnom plažom i luksuznim sadržajimaPredstavljamo vam jedinstvenu priliku za kupovinu luksuznog stana direktno na bečićkoj plaži. Smješten na prvoj liniji mora, samo 10 metara od čuvene plaže koja važi za jednu od najlepših na Jadranu, ovaj moderan stambeni kompleks u izgradnji kombinuje vrhunski dizajn, ekskluzivne sadržaje i privatnu plažu, nudeći nezaboravno iskustvo života na moru. Stanari imaju ekskluzivan privatni pristup plaži ispred objekta, a u blizini se nalaze restorani, kafići, barovi i butici koji čine život praktičnim i zabavnim.
Kompleks nudi luksuzne sadržaje za opuštanje i zabavu, uključujući zatvoreni i otvoreni bazen sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadransko more, moderno opremljen fitness centar, kazino na dva nivoa, potpuno opremljen wellness i spa centar, kao i maloprodajne prostore sa restoranima, kafićima, barovima i buticima.
Projektom je predviđena stambena zgrada od 12 spratova sa ukupno 136 stambenih jedinica i 95 parking mesta, dizajnirana da zadovolji najviše standarde udobnosti, privatnosti i luksuznog života na obali. Svi stanovi dolaze potpuno namješteni, opremljeni prozorima sa dvostrukim staklom za poboljšanu termo i zvučnu izolaciju, a koriste se samo najkvalitetniji materijali koji osiguravaju izuzetnu izdržljivost i komfor.
Stanovi su različitih rasporeda i veličina: od studija od 38 m², jednosobnih stanova od 53–69 m², dvosobnih od 84–113 m², do trosobnih stanova od 161–170 m². Cene se kreću od 269.000 € do 1.450.000 €, što definiše cenu po kvadratnom metru od 4.700 € do 8.500 €, u zavisnosti od tipa stana, sprata i rasporeda. Mesečna naknada za održavanje iznosi 6,90 € / m².
Atraktivan model plaćanja predviđa 10% prilikom rezervacije, 60% tokom izgradnje sa završetkom u decembru 2026. godine, dok se preostali iznos od 30% plaća u maju 2027. godine, a predaja stanova je planirana u periodu mart–april 2027. Grand Opening kompleksa predviđen je za leto 2027. godine.
Pored toga, postoji i atraktivan model podjele profita sa profesionalnim upravljanjem i visoko očekivanim stepenom popunjenosti – 70% za vlasnika i 30% za menadžment, što čini ovu nekretninu idealnom kako za život, tako i za investiciju.
Ovo je jedinstvena prilika za luksuzan život ili investiciju na najlepšoj plaži Budvanske rivijere, sa ekskluzivnim sadržajima, privatnom plažom i panoramskim pogledom na more.

Sale of a One-Bedroom Apartment 58 m² with Sea View in an Exclusive Residential Complex in Rafailovići – First Line to the Sea with Private Beach and Luxury AmenitiesWe present a unique opportunity to purchase a luxury apartment directly on Bečići Beach. Located on the first line to the sea, just 10 meters from the famous beach considered one of the most beautiful on the Adriatic, this modern residential complex under construction combines top-quality design, exclusive amenities, and a private beach, offering an unforgettable seaside living experience. Residents have exclusive private access to the beach in front of the building, while nearby restaurants, cafes, bars, and boutiques make life convenient and enjoyable.
The complex offers luxury facilities for relaxation and entertainment, including indoor and outdoor pools with panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea, a fully equipped modern fitness center, a two-level casino, a fully equipped wellness and spa center, and retail spaces with restaurants, cafes, bars, and boutiques.
The project features a 12-story residential building with a total of 136 residential units and 95 parking spaces, designed to meet the highest standards of comfort, privacy, and luxurious coastal living. All apartments come fully furnished, with double-glazed windows for improved thermal and sound insulation, using only the highest quality materials to ensure durability and comfort.
Apartments come in various layouts and sizes: studios of 38 m², one-bedroom apartments of 53–69 m², two-bedroom apartments of 84–113 m², and three-bedroom apartments of 161–170 m². Prices range from €269,000 to €1,450,000, defining a price per square meter of €4,700 to €8,500 depending on the type, floor, and layout. Monthly maintenance fee is €6.90/m².
The attractive payment plan includes 10% upon reservation, 60% during construction with completion in December 2026, and the remaining 30% in May 2027, with handover planned for March–April 2027. Grand Opening is scheduled for summer 2027.
Additionally, there is an attractive profit-sharing model with professional management and high expected occupancy – 70% to the owner and 30% to management, making this property ideal for both living and investment.
This is a unique opportunity for luxury living or investment on the most beautiful beach of the Budva Riviera, with exclusive amenities, a private beach, and panoramic sea views.

Cene se kreću od 269.000 € do 1.450.000 €, što definiše cenu po kvadratnom metru od 4.700 € do 8.500 €, u zavisnosti od tipa stana, sprata i rasporeda. Mesečna naknada za održavanje iznosi 6,90 € / m².
Atraktivan model plaćanja predviđa 10% prilikom rezervacije, 60% tokom izgradnje sa završetkom u decembru 2026. godine, dok se preostali iznos od 30% plaća u maju 2027. godine, a predaja stanova je planirana u periodu mart–april 2027. Grand Opening kompleksa predviđen je za leto 2027. godine.
Pored toga, postoji i atraktivan model podjele profita sa profesionalnim upravljanjem i visoko očekivanim stepenom popunjenosti – 70% za vlasnika i 30% za menadžment, što čini ovu nekretninu idealnom kako za život, tako i za investiciju.
Ovo je jedinstvena prilika za luksuzan život ili investiciju na najlepšoj plaži Budvanske rivijere, sa ekskluzivnim sadržajima, privatnom plažom i panoramskim pogledom na more.

Sale of a Two-Bedroom Apartment 113 m² in an Exclusive Modern Residential Complex in Rafailovići – First Line to the Sea with Private Beach and Luxury Amenities We present a unique opportunity to purchase a luxury apartment directly on Bečići Beach. Located on the first line to the sea, just 10 meters from the famous beach considered one of the most beautiful on the Adriatic, this modern residential complex under construction combines top-quality design, exclusive amenities, and a private beach, offering an unforgettable seaside living experience. Residents have exclusive private access to the beach in front of the building, while nearby restaurants, cafes, bars, and boutiques make life convenient and enjoyable.
The complex offers luxury facilities for relaxation and entertainment, including indoor and outdoor pools with panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea, a fully equipped modern fitness center, a two-level casino, a fully equipped wellness and spa center, and retail spaces with restaurants, cafes, bars, and boutiques.
The project features a 12-story residential building with a total of 136 residential units and 95 parking spaces, designed to meet the highest standards of comfort, privacy, and luxurious coastal living. All apartments come fully furnished, with double-glazed windows for improved thermal and sound insulation, using only the highest quality materials to ensure durability and comfort.
Apartments come in various layouts and sizes: studios of 38 m², one-bedroom apartments of 53–69 m², two-bedroom apartments of 84–113 m², and three-bedroom apartments of 161–170 m². Prices range from €269,000 to €1,450,000, defining a price per square meter of €4,700 to €8,500 depending on the type, floor, and layout. Monthly maintenance fee is €6.90/m².
The attractive payment plan includes 10% upon reservation, 60% during construction with completion in December 2026, and the remaining 30% in May 2027, with handover planned for March–April 2027. Grand Opening is scheduled for summer 2027.
Additionally, there is an attractive profit-sharing model with professional management and high expected occupancy – 70% to the owner and 30% to management, making this property ideal for both living and investment.
This is a unique opportunity for luxury living or investment on the most beautiful beach of the Budva Riviera, with exclusive amenities, a private beach, and panoramic sea views.

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 220m², Reževići, Budva
Sale, house, 220m², Reževići, Budva
listing.description:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 220 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 265 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata pet spavacih soba,pet kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje.
Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.

A luxury townhouse villa of 220 m² with a private plot of 265 m² and a swimming pool is up for sale. It is located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of spaciousness and plenty of natural light, while two terraces offer a memorable view of the Adriatic Sea.
There is a private swimming pool, a landscaped and green courtyard on the plot, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property has special advantages — the option of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of top-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time it is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica.
Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa is a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for renting out.

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 45m², Centar, Kolašin
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 45m², Centar, Kolašin
listing.description: Objekat u izgradnji pozicioniran u samom srcu Kolašina, okružen mnoštvom kafea, restorana, parkova i igrališta. U neposrednoj blizini nalaze se i pošta, dom zdravlja, supermarketi, autobuska stanica i ostali sadržaji koji u mnogome doprinose ugodnom boravku turista kao i svakodnevnim životnim potrebama. Posebna pažnja posvećena je odabiru modernih i kvalitetnih materijala koji su u kombinaciji sa tradicionalnim principima gradnje karakterističnim za ovo podneblje. U skladu sa tim, završna fasadna obloga su u jednom delu talpe od termotretiranog drveta dok je preostali deo fasade prirodni kamen debljine od 5-8cm. U delu koji se obradjuje termotretiranim drvetom, preko zidova od 20cm se postavlja termoizolacioni sloj debljine 15cm preko čega se predvidja sloj za provetravanje od 5cm i kao završni sloj pomenuto termotretirano drvo montrirano na za to predvidjenu podkonstrukciju. Zidovi čiji je finalni sloj kamen su takodje debljine 20cm i sa spoljašnjem delu se preko zida izradjuje sloj betonskog platna.Podovi na svim terasama se oblažu protivkliznom keramikom i izoluju adekvatnom hidroizolacijom. Dostupne nekretnine u sklopu kompleksa: - jednosobni stanovi od 44-45-46m2 - dvosobni stanovi od 70m2 i 90m2 - poslovni prostor od 234m2 Cijena iznosi od 2500-2600€/m2.

Property under construction located in the very heart of Kolašin, surrounded by many cafes, restaurants, parks, and playgrounds. In the immediate vicinity there are also a post office, health center, supermarkets, bus station, and other amenities which greatly contribute to a pleasant stay for tourists as well as daily life needs. Special attention has been paid to the selection of modern and quality materials which are combined with traditional construction principles characteristic of this region. Accordingly, the final facade cladding in one part consists of thermally treated wood panels, while the remaining part of the facade is natural stone with a thickness of 5-8cm. In the part treated with thermally treated wood, a 15cm thick thermal insulation layer is installed over the 20cm walls, over which a 5cm ventilation layer is provided, and as a final layer, the aforementioned thermally treated wood is mounted on its designated substructure. Walls whose final layer is stone are also 20cm thick, and on the exterior part, a layer of concrete canvas is applied over the wall. Floors on all terraces are covered with non-slip ceramic tiles and insulated with adequate waterproofing. Available properties within the complex: - one-bedroom apartments from 44-45-46m2 - two-bedroom apartments from 70m2 and 90m2 - commercial space of 234m2 The price ranges from 2500-2600€/m2.

listing.title: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 59m², Porto Montenegro, Tivat
Sale, two bedroom apartment, 59m², Porto Montenegro, Tivat
listing.description:
Objekat je pozicioniran na jednoj od najljepših lokacija u Tivtu. Riječ je o mirnoj lokaciji, na svega 800metara od mora, dok je od centra grada udaljena svega 1 kilometar. Objekat je koncipiran tako, da je svojom dužom stranom orijentisan ka moru, da bi svi stanovi imali otvoren pogled na grad i more. Objekat svojom arhitekturom i formom prati savremen način izgradnje i finalne obrade stambenih objekata. Struktura stanova u ob- jektu, sa mogućnošću objedinjavanja više stambenih jedinica u jednu, budućim korisnici- ma pruža pregršt mogućnosti u odabiru svog doma.
U podzemnim etažama organizovan je cjelokupan mirujući saobraćaj za potrebe korisnika ovog objekta. Pažljivo odabranim sadnicima visokog i niskog rastinja, parterno uređenje oko objekta biće detaljno ozelenjeno, kako bi objekat dodatno ušuškali i oplemenili... Osim navedenog, u parternom uređenju predviđena je izgradnja bazena za korisnike obog objekta...

The building is positioned in one of the most beautiful locations in Tivat. It is a quiet location, only 800 meters from the sea, while it is only 1 kilometer away from the city center. The building is designed so that its longer side is oriented towards the sea, so that all apartments have an open view of the city and the sea. With its architecture and form, the building follows modern construction methods and the final finishing of residential buildings. The structure of apartments in the building, with the possibility of combining several residential units into one, provides future users with a wealth of options in choosing their home.
In the underground floors, all stationary traffic is organized for the needs of the users of this building. With carefully selected tall and low-growing plants, the ground-level landscaping around the building will be thoroughly greened, to further nestle and enhance the building... In addition to the above, the construction of a swimming pool is planned in the ground-level landscaping for the users of this building...

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 220m², Reževići, Budva
Sale, house, 220m², Reževići, Budva
listing.description:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 220 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 154 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata pet spavacih soba,pet kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje. Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.

For sale is a luxury townhouse villa with an area of 220 m² and a private plot of 154 m² with a swimming pool, located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of spaciousness and abundance of natural light, while two terraces offer a breathtaking view of the Adriatic Sea. There is a private pool on the plot, a landscaped and green courtyard, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property brings special benefits — the possibility of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from the property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive the right to a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of top-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time it is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica. Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa represents a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for renting out.

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 200m², Krašići, Tivat
Sale, house, 200m², Krašići, Tivat
listing.description:
Na prodaju je nova luksuzna vila površine 200 m², smeštena na placu od 330 m² u mirnom i atraktivnom naselju Krašići, u opštini Tivat, svega 10 metara od plaže.
Krašići predstavljaju idealnu lokaciju za one koji traže privatnost, mir i neposrednu blizinu mora, daleko od gradske gužve, uz prelep pogled na Bokokotorski zaliv i okolne planine.
Posebnu vrednost ove vile čine panoramski pogled na more i planine iz svake sobe, privatni bazen i pažljivo osmišljen enterijer, u kojem su spojeni savremeni dizajn, kvalitetni materijali i visok nivo komfora.
Enterijer i opremljenostUnutrašnjost vile autorski je dizajnirana, sa više scenarija ambijentalnog osvetljenja koji prostoru daju poseban karakter. U završnoj obradi korišćene su italijanske keramičke pločice vrhunskog kvaliteta, dok su kupatila opremljena sanitarnom opremom renomiranih brendova Hansgrohe i Villeroy & Boch.
Vila poseduje savremene sisteme klimatizacije i ventilacije, podno grejanje i kamine, što omogućava prijatan boravak tokom cele godine.
Kvalitet gradnje i energetska efikasnostPrilikom izgradnje posebna pažnja posvećena je termoizolaciji i energetskoj efikasnosti. Ugrađeni su prozori sa dvostrukim zastakljenjem i kvalitetnim profilima renomiranog proizvođača Schüco, čime se doprinosi boljoj toplotnoj i zvučnoj izolaciji.

For sale is a new luxury villa with an area of 200 m², located on a plot of 330 m² in the peaceful and attractive settlement of Krašići, in the municipality of Tivat, just 10 meters from the beach.
Krašići is an ideal location for those who seek privacy, peace and proximity to the sea, far from the hustle and bustle of the city, with a beautiful view of the Boka Bay and the surrounding mountains.
This villa is particularly valuable for its panoramic views of the sea and mountains from every room, a private pool and a carefully designed interior, which combines modern design, quality materials and a high level of comfort.
Interior and equipmentThe interior of the villa is author's designed, with multiple ambient lighting scenarios that give the space a special character. High-quality Italian ceramic tiles were used in the final treatment, while the bathrooms are equipped with sanitary ware from reputable brands Hansgrohe and Villeroy & Boch.
The villa has modern climate control and ventilation systems, underfloor heating and fireplaces, which make it possible to enjoy a pleasant stay throughout the year.
Quality of construction and energy efficiencySpecial attention was paid to thermal insulation and energy efficiency during construction. Double-glazed windows with high-quality profiles from the renowned manufacturer Schüco have been installed, which contribute to better thermal and sound insulation.

listing.title: Stambeni kompleks u Lastvi Grbaljskoj br. 2452
Residential Complex in Lastva Grbaljska
listing.description:
Moderan stambeni kompleks u Budvi pored plaže Jaz
Novi stambeni projekat, smešten u zelenom delu Budve, u podnožju brda Budvanska Lastva. Kompleks uspešno spaja prirodni mir sa blizinom glavnih gradskih i turističkih sadržaja. Samo nekoliko minuta vožnje deli ga od centra Budve, Starog grada, marine, prodavnica, restorana, kao i čuvene plaže Jaz — jedne od najpopularnijih na čitavoj obali Crne Gore.
Projekat se sastoji od šest zasebnih stambenih zgrada, izvedenih u savremenom arhitektonskom stilu sa elementima mediteranske estetike. Korišćeni su visokokvalitetni fasadni materijali, uključujući prirodni kamen, drvo i energetski efikasne tehnologije. Zgrade su projektovane u niskogradnom formatu: sa podzemnim garažama, prizemljem i dva puna nivoa.
Kompleks je deo velikog stambenog i infrastrukturnog projekta, u koji ulaze vile, sportski tereni, zone za odmor, stambeni i komercijalni objekti. Kompleks zauzima centralno mesto u ovoj koncepciji, što ga čini posebno atraktivnim kako za život, tako i za ulaganje.
Stanovi u kompleksu projektovani su sa maksimalnom pažnjom prema komforu. Prostrane terase, funkcionalni rasporedi, velika količina prirodne svetlosti, kvalitetna termo- i zvučna izolacija, savremeni sistemi grejanja i hlađenja — sve to obezbeđuje visok nivo života tokom cele godine.
Trenutno su u prodaji dostupni različiti tipovi stanovanja: kompaktni studiji površine 29 m², 34 m² i 39 m², udobni stanovi sa jednom spavaćom sobom površine 52 m², kao i prostrani apartmani sa dve spavaće sobe površine 88 m². Svi stanovi imaju direktan ili delimičan pogled na more i okolna brda.
Na teritoriji kompleksa biće uređene zone za odmor, zelenilo i parking. Sva neophodna gradska i turistička infrastruktura nalazi se na pešačkoj udaljenosti, a pogodna lokacija čini ovaj kompleks idealnim izborom kako za lično stanovanje, tako i za investicije.
Završetak radova i puštanje objekta u upotrebu planirani su za 1. jul 2027. godine.

Modern residential complex in Kotor
A new residential project located in the green part Kotor. The complex successfully combines natural tranquility with proximity to the main urban and tourist attractions.
The project consists of six separate residential buildings designed in a modern architectural style with elements of Mediterranean aesthetics. High-quality facade materials are used, including natural stone, wood, and energy-efficient technologies. The buildings are designed in a low-rise format: with underground garages, a ground floor, and two full levels.
The complex is part of a large-scale residential and infrastructure project that includes villas, sports grounds, recreation areas, residential and commercial properties. The complex occupies a central place in this concept, which makes it especially attractive both for living and for investment.
The apartments in the complex are designed with maximum attention to comfort. Spacious terraces, well-planned layouts, plenty of natural light, high-quality thermal and sound insulation, modern heating and cooling systems — all this ensures a high standard of living all year round.
At present, various types of housing are available for sale: compact studios of 24 m2. New projects C and D 29-65m2, end of building october 2027. All apartments have direct or partial sea views and views of the surrounding hills.
The complex will feature recreation areas, greenery, and parking. All necessary urban and resort infrastructure is within walking distance, and the convenient location makes this complex an ideal choice both for personal residence and for investment.
The completion date is scheduled for Oct 1, 2027.

Modern Residential Complex in Tivat – Your New Home by the Sea
Discover the perfect blend of contemporary architecture, comfort, and Mediterranean lifestyle in an exclusive residential complex located in one of the most beautiful areas of Tivat.
Thoughtfully designed architecture, high-quality materials, and functional layouts create an ideal setting for living, relaxing, or investing on the Montenegrin coast.
The Benefits of Living Here
Attractive Location
The complex is situated in a peaceful, green neighbourhood of Tivat, just a few minutes’ walk from the beaches, restaurants, and the prestigious Porto Montenegro promenade.
High-Quality Finishes
Natural stone, premium sanitary fittings, and air-conditioning systems from renowned international manufacturers ensure a high standard of comfort and aesthetics.
Functional and Light-Filled Spaces
Panoramic windows allow plenty of natural light to enter, while carefully planned layouts ensure optimal use of space.
Professional Property Management
An experienced professional management company will be responsible for overseeing the complex, ensuring easier maintenance and a more comfortable living experience.
Location – Everything You Need Within Easy Reach
Situated in a peaceful part of Tivat, the complex offers the perfect balance between privacy and proximity to essential amenities.
Shops, restaurants, well-maintained beaches, and the Porto Montenegro promenade are all within walking distance. Tivat International Airport is just a ten-minute drive away, making this location particularly convenient for permanent residence, holidays, and year-round living.
Tivat is a city that combines Mediterranean charm, modern infrastructure, and a vibrant lifestyle, offering a unique residential experience on the Adriatic coast.
About the Complex
The development consists of two residential buildings – Block A and Block B – featuring a carefully designed selection of apartments with different layouts.
The available apartments include one- and two-bedroom units, spacious living rooms, and terraces that provide additional space to relax and enjoy the Mediterranean climate.
Ground-floor apartments feature private gardens, ideal for outdoor relaxation and enjoying greater privacy.
Apartment sizes range from 42 m² to 90 m², offering options to suit a variety of needs – from a comfortable home for individuals and couples to a practical solution for families.
Thanks to the panoramic windows, the interiors are filled with natural light, while most apartments offer beautiful views of the sea and the city.
Invest in Quality of Life
Whether you are looking for a new home on the Montenegrin coast, a holiday retreat, or a property with investment potential, this residential complex in Tivat offers an opportunity to enjoy the perfect combination of contemporary living, an attractive location, and a Mediterranean atmosphere.

listing.title: Dvosoban Stan Portonovi
Portonovi 2 bedroom Spacious Apartment
listing.description:
Površina: 171 m2 (142 m2 + 29 m2 terasa)
Spavaćih soba: 2
Kupatila: 2
Garaža: 1
Ovaj prostrani dvosobni stan nalazi se u okviru **Village Residences** u prestižnom rizortu **Portonovi**, jednoj od najekskluzivnijih lifestyle destinacija u Crnoj Gori.
Stan ima ukupnu površinu od 171 m2, uključujući 142 m2 unutrašnjeg prostora i terasu od 29 m2 sa pogledom na uređenu baštu i bazen. Sastoji se od svijetlog dnevnog boravka otvorenog koncepta sa trpezarijom, potpuno opremljene moderne kuhinje, dvije komforne spavaće sobe i dva kupatila.
Cijena uključuje jedno garažno mjesto, kao i sav ugradni namještaj i kuhinjske aparate marke Miele.
Pogodan plan otplate: 15% prilikom potpisivanja kupoprodajnog ugovora, a preostali iznos na 36 mjeseci bez kamate.
Portonovi je ultra-premium rizortna lifestyle destinacija koja obuhvata 218 rezidencijalnih jedinica svjetske klase i vrhunsku marinu za mega jahte, smještenu na najužem dijelu ulaza u Boku Kotorsku.
Portonovi ima odličan položaj između planina i mora, s ambijentalnim pogledom na netaknutu jadransku obalu. Portonovi uključuje prvi evropski One & Only resort, luksuzne rezidencije, Henri Chenot destinacijski zdravstveni i wellness spa centar, marinu svjetske klase koja služi mega jahtama (s povratom poreza na gorivo do 40%), najveću pješčanu plažu u regiji s luksuznim beach klubom.

Area: 171 m2 (142 m2 + 29 m2 terrace)
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 2
Garage: 1
This spacious two-bedroom apartment is located within Village Residences at the prestigious Portonovi Resort, one of Montenegro’s most exclusive lifestyle destinations.
The apartment offers 171 m2 total area, including 142 m2 of interior space and a 29 m2 terrace overlooking the landscaped garden and swimming pool. It features a bright open-plan living room with dining area, a fully equipped modern kitchen, two comfortable bedrooms, and two bathrooms.
The price includes one garage space and all fixed furniture and Miele kitchen appliances.
Convenient payment plan: 15% upon signing the SPA, and the remaining amount through 36 months interest free.
Portonovi is an ultra-premium resort lifestyle destination that includes 218 world-class housing units and a top marina for mega yachts, at the narrowest part of the entrance to the Bay of Kotor.
Portonovi has an excellent position between the mountains and the sea, with an ambient view of the untouched Adriatic coast. Portonovi includes Europe’s first One & Only resort, luxury residences, Henri Chenot destination health and Wellness Spa, a world-class marina serving mega yachts (with fuel tax rebates of up to 40%), the region’s largest sandy beach with a luxury beach club.

listing.title: Privatna kuća, Portonovi
Portonovi Private Home
listing.description:
Stambena površina: 571 m2 (396 m2 + terase 175 m2)
Spoljna površina u korišćenju: 1.225 m2
Spavaćih soba: 3
Kupatila: 3 + 1
Parkirna mjesta: 3
Garsonjere za osoblje: 2
Vanjski bazen
Privatna plaža
Privatni vez
One&Only Private Home, poznata i kao brendirana rezidencija ili One&Only vila, najekskluzivnija je nekretnina na jadranskoj rivijeri. Ova vila tipa Rumija sa tri spavaće sobe ima 571 m2.
Struktura vile:
Prizemlje: prostran dnevni boravak sa trpezarijom i kuhinjom, toalet za goste, vešernica, ostava, prostorija za otpad, tehnička prostorija i dva studija za osoblje, svaki sa spavaćom sobom, kupatilom i čajnom kuhinjom. Sa terase dnevnog boravka izlazi se direktno na spoljni bazen i plažu.
Prvi sprat: tri spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima, svaka sa privatnom terasom, i prostrana krovna terasa za odmor i opuštanje.
Ova zadivljujuća vila uz more ima:
• tri spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima
• privatni bazen
• privatna pješčana plaža
• privatni mol
• privatna bašta sa terasom za obroke na otvorenom
• dvije jednokrevetne sobe za osoblje sa sopstvenim kupatilima i čajnom kuhinjom
• posvećena usluga batlera
Cijena vile uključuje luksuzan namještaj po standardima One&Only; budući vlasnici moći će i da uključe vilu u program jedinica kojima upravlja One&Only i izdaju je preko sistema rezervacija One&Only. Program izdavanja je veoma fleksibilan, bez obaveznih termina korišćenja i sličnih ograničenja, a vlasništvo je puno.
One&Only Portonovi smješten je na ulazu u Boku, mjesto svjetske baštine UNESCO-a poznato po izuzetnoj prirodnoj ljepoti, bogatoj lokalnoj kulturi i istorijski važnoj venecijanskoj arhitekturi, čiji dio potiče još iz 9. vijeka.
Portonovi Montenegro je najekskluzivnija rizort destinacija na Jadranu, sa 290 nekretnina svjetske klase i najsavremenijom marinom za mega jahte, na najužem dijelu ulaza u Bokokotorski zaliv. Portonovi ima izuzetan položaj između planine i mora, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na netaknutu jadransku obalu. Obuhvata prvi One&Only rizort u Evropi, luksuzne rezidencije, medicinski i velnes spa Henri Chenot, marinu svjetske klase za mega jahte koja radi cijele godine (sa poreskim olakšicama na gorivo do 40%) i najveću pješčanu plažu u regionu sa luksuznim beach klubom. Tu su i prodavnice, kafići i restorani uz obalu.

Residential area: 571 m2 (396 m2 + 175 m2 terraces)
External usage area: 1,225 m2
Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 3 + 1
Parking spaces: 3
Staff studios: 2
Outdoor pool
Private beach
Private berth
One&Only Private Home, also known as a branded residence or One&Only Villa, represents the trophy property in the Adriatic Riviera. This three-bedroom Rumija-type villa is 571 m2 in size.
Villa structure:
Ground floor: spacious living room with a dining area and a kitchen, guest toilet, laundry, storage, waste room, plant room, and two staff studios, each consisting of a bedroom, bathroom, and kitchenette. There is direct access to the outdoor pool and beach from the living room terrace.
First floor: three en suite bedrooms, each with a private terrace, and a spacious roof deck, suitable for lounging and relaxing.
This stunning ocean villa features:
• three bedrooms and en-suite bathrooms
• private pool
• private sandy beach
• private jetty
• private garden with terrace for outdoor dining
• two single-bedded service rooms with en-suite bathrooms and kitchenette
• dedicated butler service
The price for this villa includes luxury furniture designed as per One&Only standards; future owners will also have an opportunity to participate in the pool of One&Only operated units and let their villa via the One&Only booking system. The rental program is very flexible, has no limitations in terms of mandatory dates/usage, etc, and the ownership is freehold.
One&Only Portonovi is positioned at the graceful entrance to Boka Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its exquisite natural beauty, rich local culture, and historically important Venetian architecture, some of which date back to the 9th century.
Portonovi Montenegro is the Adriatic’s ultra-premium resort lifestyle destination embracing 290 world-class properties and a state-of-art mega-yacht marina, located at the narrowest part of the entrance of the Bay of Boka Kotorska. Portonovi commands an excellent position between mountain and sea, with breathtaking views of the pristine Adriatic coastline. Portonovi includes Europe’s first One&Only resort, luxury residences, a Henri Chenot destination Medical and Wellness Spa, an all-season, world-class marina catering to megayachts (with tax reliefs on the fuel of up to 40%), the region’s largest sand beach with luxury beach club. Other features include waterfront shops, cafes, and restaurants.

Two-bedroom apartment, Harmonia complex Becici
listing.description:
Namješten stan od 92 m2, sa dvije spavaće sobe i pogledom na more u ekskluzivnom stambenom kompleksu Harmonija u Bečićima, Budva.
Stan se sastoji od prostranog dnevnog boravka otvorenog plana sa trpezarijom, potpuno opremljene kuhinje, 1 kupatila, 2 spavaće sobe i velike terase sa pogledom na more i cijele Bečiće.

Furnished apartment of 92 m2, with two bedrooms and sea view in the exclusive Harmonia residential complex in Bečići, Budva.
The apartment consists of a spacious open-plan living room with a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen, 1 bathroom, 2 bedrooms and a large terrace with a view of the sea and the whole of Bečići.
The apartment is equipped with modern furniture, quality household appliances, split-system air conditioning, video intercom, fire alarm system, Smart-house system, high-speed internet and cable television.
The Harmonia residential complex is a luxurious apartment complex located in the most attractive place on the Budva Riviera, between Bečići and Budva. The distance of the complex from the sea is 100 m, and from the Old Town in Budva 2.5 km.
